༄༅/ /rnam par bshad pa'i chu rgyun bzhi pa bzhugs so/ /oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ/rnam dag thabs tshul zab mo yis/ /rnam mang 'gro ba srid mtsho las/ /rnam pa

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rnam par bshad pa'i chu rgyun bzhi pa bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ/ rnam dag thabs tshul zab mo yis/ /rnam mang 'gro ba srid mtsho las/ /rnam par bsgral phyir brtson pa yis/ /rnam grol mchog mnyes bla mar 'dud/ /thabs ma yin las skyabs pa'i phyir/ /thabs mchog ston pa khyed rnams kyis/ /thabs min la zhugs skye bo rnams/ /thabs mkhas thugs rjes bskyab tu gsol/ /sems bskyed brgyud pa med pa dang / /rjes 'dzin grangs nges med pa dang / /sta gon 'brel pa med pa dang / /slob dpon grangs nges med pa dang / /lus dkyil 'byung khungs med pa dang / /dbang rdzas yongs dag med pa dang / /rgyas gdab rigs mtshon med pa dang / /bza' ba'i dam tshig med pa yis/ /'di na thabs mchog thabs min byed/ /smin byed byas kyang smin min la/ /grol byed bsgom kyang grol min pas/ /de phyir 'di dag dgag par bya/ /de la ding sang 'di na/ kyai rdo rje'i dbang bskur gyi sngon du/ brgyud pa gnyis kyi lugs su byed pa'i skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa'i cho ga zhes pa/ rje btsun chen po'i mdzad byang can 'di/ maṇḍal tshom bu lnga pa la brten te/ slob ma la sbyin pa'i lag len byed do/ /'di ni gzhan las khyad par bya ba'i phyir dpe lag tu thob pa tsam la brgyud pa med par rang 'tshams kyis byas par mngon to/ /gal te brgyud pa yod pa zhig yin na/ gzhan la yang snang dgos pa las/ chos 'di pa'i brgyud pa'i srol 'dzin su la yang mi snang ba'i phyir te/ 'di ltar rgyal ba brag phug pa nas/ lam 'bras pa ye shes dpal dang / blo bzang dkar mo nas brgyud pa'i mang dkar ba'i slob ma rnams dang / brag phug pa nas/ chos rje dkon rgyal ba dang / sa skya bu ston nas brgyud pa/ theg chen chos rje'i slob brgyud rnams dang / brag phug pa nas/ bla ma dam pa la brgyud pa'i chos rje bzung gi dpal ba'i slob brgyud rnams dang /

bla ma dam pa nas yar lung pa seng ge rgyal mtshan nas brgyud pa'i slob brgyud rnams dang / bla ma dam pa nas/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims la brgyud de/ bla ma nam mkha' dpal bzang dang / chos rje sgrub chen nas brgyud pa'i slob brgyud rnams dang / bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims nas/ chos rje bzang po rgyal mtshan las brgyud pa'i slob brgyud rnams dang / bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims nas/ chos rje buddha shrī dang / rdor gling rin po che las brgyud pa'i slob brgyud rnams dang / yang / brag phug pa nas brgyud mi dgos pa/ tshogs bsgom/ nyan chen pa/ bla ma 'jam skya'o/ /mnyam med chos rje las brgyud pa'i slob brgyud rnams te/ de rnams su la yang yi ge 'di'i cho ga phyag len dang bcas te rgyud sde 'ongs pa med do/ /der ma zad/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje pas bla ma rje btsun chen po'i gsung rab rnams/ bla ma bcu gcig las lung len par mdzad pa/ ding sang gi bka' 'bum thob yig rnams su yi ge 'di ma byung bas/ bla ma bcu gcig po de dag la yang lung tsam yang mi bzhugs par snang la/ bka' 'bum snga sgrigs gang na yang med cing / dpe 'di sgo rum dpe khang nas ngor chen gyis rnyed do zhes zer bas/ brgyud pa de rtogs pa yin no/ /yang kha cig slob ma rjes 'dzin gyi skabs su nyi shu rtsa lnga las thal te brgya phrag du ma dag la rjes 'dzin gyi cho ga phyogs gcig tu byed do/ /'di ni shin tu mi rigs te/ spyir rgyud kyi lung dang 'gal ba dang / rje btsun gong ma'i gsung dang 'gal ba dang / rang gi sta gon sogs kyi grangs nges dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /dang po spyi rgyud kyi lung dang 'gal te/ de nyid las/ mkhas pas slob ma gcig gam gsum/ /lnga 'am yang na bdun dag gam/ /nyi shu rtsa ni lnga yi bar/ /zung du ma gyur slob ma bzung / /de bas lhag pa'i slob ma ni/ /yongs su gzung bar mi shis so/

/zhes nyer lnga las lhag pa dngos su bkag pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa rje btsun gong ma'i gsung dang 'gal te/ dbang chu chen po las de ltar 'brel brtags nas mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i slob ma gcig nas nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bar kha yar ba gzung bar bya'o/ /kha 'chams pa dang de las lhag pa dkyil 'khor gcig tu mi bzung ste/ de skad du/ mkhas pas slob ma gcig gam gsum/ /zhes sogs grangs te gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa rang gi sta gon sogs kyis grangs nges dang 'gal te/ sta gon kyi skabs kyi slob ma'i grangs nges/ rjes 'dzin la ltos dgos kyi/ de las gzhan pa'i sta gon gyi grangs nges/ spyi rgyud dang / rje btsun gong ma'i dbang chu'i yi ge gang du yang ma gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang spyi rgyud las/ slob ma yongs su bzung ba gang / /sta gon gnas tshe med na ni/ /de yi gzugs brnyan byas nas ni/ /ji skad gsung pa'i las rnams bya/ /slob ma yongs su bzung ba gang / /gal te rkyen 'ga' zhig gis ni/ /der ni 'ongs par ma gyur na/ /gzhan zhig de'i skyin par bzhugs/ /zhes gsung pa 'di las gzhan pa'i sta gon gyi skabs kyi slob ma'i grangs nges ma gsungs pas/ rjes bzung gi dus kyi slob ma'i grangs gang yod kyi nang nas la la dag sta gon gyi dus su ma tshang na gang ma tshang ba de nyid kyis gzugs brnyan bya ba'am/ yang na/ slob ma gzhan dag grangs mthun gyis kha bskang ste tshang bar byas nas sta gon bya bar gsungs pas/ brgya phrag du ma la rjes gzung gi cho ga byas pas/ thams cad tshang bar yod bzhin du/ nyer lnga las lhag pa la sta gon mi byed pa 'gal ba'i phyir dang / lhag ma rnams la yang gzugs brnyan nam/ gzhan skyin par 'jug pa dag mi byed pa 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /gal te gzugs brnyan nam/ gzhan skyin par bzhugs pa dag phyag len la ma mthong bas mi byed do zhe na/ 'o na nyer lnga las lhag pa la rjes gzung gi cho ga byed pa yang ma mthong bzhin du ci phyir byed/

dbang dngos gzhi'i skabs kyi grangs nges kyang / spyi rgyud las/ sta gon gnas pa byas pa la/ /gal te rkyen gyis ma 'ongs na/ /bla ma blo ldan mkhas pa yis/ /der ni slob ma gzhan mi gzung / /zhes gsungs pas/ rgyud sde las dngos gzhi'i grangs nges slob ma rjes 'dzin gyi grangs la ltos par gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /yang kha cig slob ma mang po dag la dbang bskur byed pa'i tshe/ nub dang po la bdag bskyed tshar nas sa'i lha mo sta gon/ lha sta gon/ bum pa sta gon rnams byas nas/ sta gon gsum po de nyid dang 'brel par/ slob ma nyi shu rtsa lnga la/ slob ma sta gon byas te/ sang nyin rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bris nas/ sgrub mchod byas te/ kha sang sta gon byas pa'i slob ma rnams la dbang bskur byed pa de nyid tshul dang mthun mod/ de man chad kyi slob ma rnams la/ dbang bskur de nyid rdzogs ma thag slob ma nyi shu rtsa lnga pa gzhan zhig bos te slob ma sta gon byas nas/ dkyil 'khor de nyid la bsgrub mchod byas te/ kha sang sta gon byas pa de rnams la dbang bskur bar byed cing / de ma thag gzhan nyi shu rtsa lnga pa sta gon byed de/ de ltar rgyud mar ma rdzogs kyi bar du byed do/ /gnyis pa man chad de rnams ni shin tu mi rigs pa kho na yin te/ rje btsun sa skya pa'i srol 'dzin thams cad zhal mthun par/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas/ slob ma ma smin pa smin byed kyi dbang bskur lan gcig las mi rung ste/ sta gon gyi cho ga gcig las med pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs zhing / phyag len la yang gnang ba la/ khyed kyis bu ston pa'i slob brgyud rnams kyis de ltar du byed pa mthong nas 'dir sbyar ba yin gyi/ rje btsun gong ma rnams kyi bzhed pa dang / phyag len ma yin te/ de ltar bya bar gang du yang ma bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /gal te gong ma'i bshad khungs yod na ston cig gzhan yang rigs pas kyang 'thad par ma mthong ste/

slob ma sta gon gyi cho ga yang / sta gon gyi cho ga gzhan gang dang yang ma 'brel bar byar rung na/ dngos gzhi dbang bskur yang / dngos gzhi'i cho ga gzhan gang yang ma 'brel bar byar rung bar mtshungs pa'i phyir dang / de gnyis khyad par 'byed pa'i don mthun gyi lung rigs gang yang med pa'i phyir dang / de ltar na cho ga'i go rim thams cad/ smyon pa'i spyod pa ltar yid brtan ci yang med par 'gyur ba'i phyir dang / gal te mdun gyi dkyil 'khor la sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor yang bzhugs shing / bum pa rnams kyang sta gon gyi dus kyi bum pa las gzhan ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /don tshang la/ de'i phyir byar rung ngo snyam na/ de ltar na/ dbang bskur gnyis pa man chad rnams la dngos gzhi'i dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod kyang mi dgos par 'gyur te/ dngos gzhi'i dkyil 'khor yang bzhugs pa'i phyir/ de ltar slob ma sta gon cho ga rnam dag las ma 'ong pas/ byas kyang sta gon du mi 'gyur te/ sdom pa gsum gyi rab tu dbye ba las/ cho ga cung zad nyams pa la/ /cho ga 'chags par ma gsungs na/ /cho ga phal cher nyams pa la/ /cho ga 'chags par 'gyur re rkan/ /zhes gsungs la/ sta gon ma byas pa la dngos gzhi'i cho ga byas kyang / ma smin pa smin byed kyi dbang du mi 'gyur te/ gong gi spyi rgyud kyi lung / der ni slob ma gzhan mi gzung / /zhes gsung pas/ slob ma gzhan mi bzung ba ci'i phyir zhe na/ sta gon ma byas pa la dbang dngos gzhi bskur du mi rung ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes pa'i don te/ 'di la kha cig na re/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor gyi logs shig tu/ tshom bu la sogs pa byas te/ bdag gi rnal 'byor dang / sta gon thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byas nas/ sang nyin rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor de nyid du/ dbang bskur na rnam par dag par 'gyur ba 'dra'o/ /zhes zer ro/ /de ni mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len dang bshad pa la med pas 'thad par mi nus shing /

der ma zad sta gon byas pa'i gnas de nyid du bris pa'i dkyil 'khor ma yin pas/ 'brel ci yang med par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /'on te/ de'i sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor nam mkha' la bteg pa/ rdul tshon la bsres pas 'brel lo zhe na/ 'o na khyed rang gi lugs la sta gon gyi cho ga sta gon ma byas kyang skyon med par 'gyur te/ spyan 'dren gyi skabs su sangs rgyas thams cad spyan 'dren la/ de dag gis nang na/ gnas gzhan dag tu sta gon byas pa'i lha yang yod cing sgrub mchod kyi skabs su bsres pa'i 'brel pa'i phyir ro/ /yang kha cig rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi skabs su/ slob ma der 'jug pa thams cad la dus gcig tu rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang bskur ba'i cho ga byed do/ /de yang shin tu mi rigs te/ slob dpon rin po che'i 'grel pa lugs kyi dbang chu las/ gsol gdab kyi rjes su/ de nas slob dpon gyi tshogs pa la dbang bskur bar bya ba ma yin te/ slob dpon snying rje chen po yis/ /slob ma dam pa snying rje can/ /sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin pa po/ /gcig ni nan tan skyed byed bzung / /slob ma re re la dbang bzhi gcig char ram/ rim can du bskur bar bya ba yin pas/ gzhan skye la ji skad du bshad pa'i dbang stegs kyi steng du/ slob ma'i gtso bo sngar dngos grub kyi rdo rje'i rtul zhugs kyi skabs su bstan pa'i rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag rgya chen pos bzhag la/ dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /zhes dang / khyad par du man ngag lugs kyi dbang chu chen mo las/ slob dpon gyi dbang gi gsol btab gyi rjes su/ de nas slob ma gcig dbang stegs kyi steng du bzhag la/ rdo rje 'chang chen po'i rnam par bsam zhes dang / su pra tiṣṭhas me tog gtor ba'i rjes su/ de ltar slob ma re re nas rdzogs pa dang / slob ma rnams la dus gcig tu de kho na nyid bstan par byas te/

zhes gsung pa rnams ma mthong ngam ci/ gang bkag pa de nan gyis bsgrub pa la brtson pa byed par zad do/ /yang / kha cig na re/ bka' bcu pa gzhon nu seng ge'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor du/ snying gar hūm̐ las mi bskyod pa yab yum dang phyogs bzhir bhrūm̐ am̐ dzriṃ kham̐/ mtshams bzhir lam̐ mam̐ pam̐ tam̐ las 'khor gyi lha mo rnams dang / mgrin pa'i rtsa 'khor la dbus su am̐ las 'od dpag med pa yab yum dang / 'dab ma rnams la ā li bcu drug yongs su gyur pa las/ 'khor gyi lha mo rnams bskyed par bshad pa ni mi 'thad de/ 'dir lus dkyil gyi lha rnams ni/ rtsa yi ge'i gzugs su gnas pa dang / de'i nang gi khams rnams rgyur gyur pa las skad cig gis bskyed pa yin gyi/ sa bon las bskyed pa ni ma yin te/ yin na/ sa bon gyi yi ge haṃ yig mthur du bstan pa dang / hūm̐ yig mgo mthur du bstan pa bsgom mkhan mi yong ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes zer zhing / ngag 'don gyi skabs su/ lte ba 'khor lo'i rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi pa'i lte bar aṃ/ nga rgya dang ser sna dang / tshor ba'i phung po rnam par dag pa bcom ldan 'das yon tan rin chen 'byung ldan/ zhes sogs brjod nas haṃ las zhes pa dang / hūm̐ las zhes pa dang / oṃ las zhes sogs kyi 'byung khungs kyi tshig rnams nan gyis 'dor bar byed do/ /de ni rje btsun gong ma yab sras rjes 'brang dang bcas pa phyogs gcig tu 'gog par byed pa'i smra ba ste/ slob dpon rin po ches lung 'di nyid dang zhib tu sbyar ba las/ le'u gnyis pa'i skabs su/ bhrūm̐ sogs ni lus kyi dkyil 'khor pho brang rnams bskyed pa'i sa bon 'di lngas bya ba'am/ tsaṇḍa li dang rjes su mthun par bya ba gang rung yin la/ zhes sa bon las bskyed par gsal bar gsung pa dang / rnam 'grel sras don ma las/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo aṃ las bcom ldan 'das yon tan rnam par dag pa rin chen 'byung ldan/

zhes dang / de bzhin du ha sogs la yang 'byung khungs kyi sgra sbyar te gsung pa dang / gzhan yang / zhu byas ma/ ldan bu ma/ glog skya ma/ yum don ma/ ban dhe gshin rje ma/ zla rgyal ma/ 'a 'u rnams kyis lus dkyil gyi rigs lnga thams cad la/ re re zhing yang / aṃ las zhes dang / ha las zhes dang / hūm̐ las zhes sogs 'byung khungs kyi tshig kho na yod cing / rjes 'brang gi yi ger yang / dkar gyi rdo rje'i tshig rkang gi 'grel pa dang / bla ma dmar gyis mdzad pa'i dmar ma dang / bla ma dam pas mdzad pa sogs su yang / de kho na bzhin yod la/ lus kyi rtsa khams las bskyed pa'i tshig khyad par du sbyar ba dga' steng ma dang dpe mdzad ma gnyis su yang / de'i lte ba'i nang gi aṃ gi byang sems las/ bcom ldan 'das rin chen 'byung ldan zhes dang / phyi'i rtsa aṃ las de'i yum sa rnam par dag pa spyan ma zhes dang / gzhan yang gsang gnas su ha las 'phrin las rnam par dag pa zhes dang / snying gar hūm̐ las zhes sogs thams cad la 'byung khungs kyis tshig sbyar zhing / khyad par du/ gnyag ma'i gsal byed gsum gyi nang tshan gyi lus dkyil gyi yi ger/ de las lte bar aṃ las bcom ldan 'das yon tan rnam par dag pa rin chen 'byung ldan zhes dang / gsang gnas su ha las phrin las rnam par dag pa don yod grub pa zhes dang / mgrin par oṃ las gsung rdo rje zhes dang / spyi bor haṃ las sku rdo rje/ zhes lan gcig ma yin par gsungs pa la/ de skad du smra bar nus pa shin tu ya mtshan no/ /yang kha cig brtul zhugs kyi dbang dang / rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang la/ dbang rdzas kyi bskyed chog mi byed do/ /de la da dung gong du bogs dbyung du yod dam med/ dang po ltar na khyed rang gi yi ge'i mjug tu gang zag so sos 'di la 'phri mnan ma byed cig ces ci'i phyir smra/ gal te bogs dbyung du med na/ shin tu mi rigs te/ rje btsun gyi lam dus kyi dbang gi yi ger/

de la thun mong gi dbang drug rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang dang bdun ka'i bdag dang dbang rdzas gnyis ka yongs su dag pa bzhis byin gyis brlab dgos te/ de'ang dam tshig pa ni rgyu dus kyi dang mi 'dra ste/ pho brang lnga'i gtso bor 'pho/ rdo rje 'chang yang zhal gcig phyag gnyis par 'pho la/ lhag ma rnams ni rgyu dus kyi dang khyad par med de zhes gsungs pa la/ ci'i phyir/ brtul zhugs dang / rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang la dbang rdzas la bskyed chog mi dgos pa yin/ yang kha cig rgyas gdab kyi skabs su/ saṃ bhu ṭi las/ rdo rje sems dpa' zhes byar bshad/ /bde ba dam pa ru ni brjod/ /zhes pa 'khor lo drug tu 'dod pa rnams kyi lugs la/ spyi gtsug gi 'khor lo rdo rje sems dpa' bsgom pa la 'bru mnan pas chog mod/ man ngag 'di pa'i lugs la/ rgyas 'debs kyis lha bstan pa yin zhing / de dang mthun par slob dpon dgra las rnam rgyal gyis/ phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas 'debs las/ kun gyi dbang bskur gnas su ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' zla ba'i mdog /ces bshad pas lus dkyil gyi lha la rdo rje sems dpa'i rgyas 'debs pa rgyud dang rgya gar ba'i dgongs pa yin par gsal lo/ /zhes zer zhing / ngag don gyi skabs su/ lus dkyil gyi lha thams cad la rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan/ ces zer ro/ /de las saṃ bhu ṭi'i lung des/ rigs bdag gi rgyas gdab ston par gang las bshad/ gnad kyi gsal byed las ni/ gsang ba la ni sa'i khams zhes pa nas brtsam ste/ chos kyi skur ni rab tu grags/ /zhes pa'i bar gyi rang 'byung gi ye shes kyi mtshan nyid ston pa la/ de la rgyas par bstan pa dang / bsdus te bstan pa dang / shin tu bsdus te bstan pa'o/ /dang po la gsum/ rten zhu ba 'byung ba lngar bstan pa/ brten pa bde ba ye shes lngar bstan pa/ de nyid rigs lngar bstan pa/ zhes gsung pa'i rigs lngar bstan pa'i skabs su/

shin tu rnam dag ye shes tshogs/ /rdo rje sems dpa' zhes byar bshad/ /ces pa'i tshig rkang gnyis bsdebs te/ mi bskyod pa rdo rje sems dpa' gnyis ka phyogs gcig tu thams cad bdag nyid kyis ston pa'i gzhung yin pas de ni rgyas par bstan pa'i skabs yin la/ bde ba dam pa ru ni brjod/ /ces pa ni/ bsdus te bstan pa la/ rten thig le bsdus te bstan pa dang / brten pa bde stong bsdus te bstan pa gnyis kyi/ brten pa bde stong bsdus te bstan pa yin par gsungs pas/ gzhung mtshams kyang tha dad cing / rigs bdag gi rgyas gdab ston par dogs pa'i gnas tsam yang med la/ rang blos sbyar bas rje btsun gong ma'i lugs su 'gyur ram ci/ slob dpon dgra las rnam rgyal ba'i gzhung yang / pho brang drug po ston pa'i gzhung yin gyi/ rigs bdag gi rgyas gdab ston pa'i gzhung ma yin te/ gzhung gi skabs la dpyad pas shes pa yin no/ /de ltar na/ sgrub byed rnam par dag pa med bzhin du rje btsun gyi gsung rnams dor nas gzhan smra ba 'di la dgos pa ci zhig yod/ 'o na rje btsun gong ma'i gsung las ji ltar bshad ce na/ sras don ma las/ dbang stegs ni lha thams cad la blangs na gtso bo lnga la sku rdo rje rnam snang la sogs pa'i rigs lnga/ 'khor rnams la rang rang gi gtso bo'am/ yang na thams cad kyi dbu la gnas lngar rdo rje rtse lnga pa re re bsam mo/ /zhes dang / 'phags pa rin po ches/ gtso bo lnga la rdo rje sems dpa'/ pho brang lnga'i 'khor rnams la rang rang gi gtso bo/ skye mched kyi lha rnams la rang rang gi kha dog dang mthun pa'i rigs bdag khro bo bcu la srung 'khor gyi skabs nas 'byung ba bzhin/ rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan par bsam mo/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /'o na bshad pa gnyis po ma mthun pas 'phags pas gsung pa de mi 'thad do zhe na/ mi mthun par snang ba ni brgyud pa'i man ngag med par/

yi ge la thugs phrad du byas pa'i smra ba ste/ 'dir rdo rje sems dpa' ni/ rigs lnga po rang rang gi rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa yin pas/ rang rigs kyis rgyas btab pa yang yin la/ rdo rje sems dpas rgyas btab pa yang yin pas don gcig yin no/ /yang kha cig na re/ dbang bskur dang rab gnas la sogs pa'i dus su yang / rab tu byung ba rnams kyis tshogs kyi 'khor lo bya ba ma yin te/ chos kyi rje sa skya paṇḍi tas bkag pa'i phyir/ zhes dang / de la yang dpa' bo dang dpa' mo gnyis ka 'dus na tshogs kyi 'khor lo zhes bya la/ dpa' bo gcig pu 'dus pa la ni dpa' bo'i ston mo zhes bya'i/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo zhes mi bya'o/ /zhes zer bar grag go /de la dang po de nyid ni rnam par ma brtags pa'i smra ba ste/ chos kyi rjes tshogs kyi yo byad la/ lugs gnyis las/ rab tu byung ba sdom brtson gyi lugs la ni gtor ma la sha dang chang la sogs pa dbul/ sdom brtson rnams kyi lce la bdud rtsi reg ste/ myang tsam bya/ gzhan bu ram dang shing tog la sogs pa la/ gsang ba la sogs pa gtor ma byin gyis brlab pa ltar bya/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lngar bsgom ste zos pas rtsa ltung bcu gsum pa'i nyes pa mi 'byung / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang / ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis byin gyis brlab bo/ /zhes dang / rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i lugs ni/ ma da na dang ba la sogs pa dam tshig gi rdzas ci tshogs pa la gsang ba la sogs pa byin rlabs sngar dang mthun par bya/ zhes sogs gsungs pas/ tshogs kyi yo byad la khyad par gsungs kyi/ sdom brtson rnams kyi tshogs 'khor mi bya zhes gtan gsungs pa med pa'i phyir dang / de'i phyir khyed kyi cho ga'i skabs so so dang / dus khyad par can rnams su/ sdom brtson gyi cho ga gsung pa 'di yang ma byas pas/ cho ga'i yan lag nyams pa dang / khyad par gyi bza' ba'i dam tshig nyams pa'i phyir dang /

de'i 'gal spong du/ 'o na sbyang rtogs sbar gsum dngos su bya mi nus pa la/ tshogs 'khor mi rung par snang la/ de ltar na/ las dang po pas dbang bskur gyi dus dang / dam tshig tu bza' ba'i dam tshig gsungs pa de nyams par 'gyur ro snyam na/ de ni cho ga bzhin du bsgrub pa'i bdud rtsi ril bu brten pas don grub pa yin no/ /zhes zer ro/ /de ni rgyun gyi bza' ba'i dam tshig dang / khyad par gyi bza' ba'i dam tshig ma chad pa'i smra ba yin zhing / khyad par du bdud rtsi ril bu myang ba kho nas/ sdom brtson gyi tshogs 'khor gyi go chod par/ chos kyi rjes gsungs pa med pa'i phyir dang / sdom brtson gyi de lta bu yang / rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras kyi bzhed pa ni ma yin te/ de yang chos rje nyid kyi bzhed pa ni ma yin te/ des na rgya gar gyi slob dpon klu sgrub yab sras/ thogs med sku mched nas bzung ste/ jo bo rje dang / kho bo'i mkhan po bsod snyoms pa chen po la sogs pa rnams kyis tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i lugs 'di yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang / de nyid rje btsun yab sras kyi bzhed pa yin na/ rtsa ltung 'khrul spong du/ ltung ba bcu gsum pa'i ltung ba'i ngo bo nyid rnam par bzhag pa'i thad du/ yang rab tu byung ba la sogs pa'i bcings pa'am/ phyi dro'i zas brten pa'i ltung ba byung du dogs pa'i bsam pas mi brten pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ji ltar drangs/ gal te bslab pas bcings pa sogs kyis mi brten pa ma yin gyi/ bstan pa la bag yangs su byas dogs pas yin no zhe na/ 'o na sdom brtson gyi lugs de byas pas bag yangs su mi byed pa la ci zhig gnod/ gnyis pa dpa' bo gcig bu 'dus pa la tshogs kyi 'khor lo zhes gdags su mi rung bar smra ba de ni shin tu yang ma brtags pa'i smra ste/ ngag don bsdus na/ dpa' bo'i ston mo tshogs kyi 'khor lo yin te/ khyad par gyi bza' ba'i dam tshig tshogs kyi 'khor lo yin pa'i phyir/

de ltar yang / mngon rtogs ljon shing las/ khyad par gyi bza' ba'i dam tshig gi ni tshogs kyi 'khor lo ste/ de la gnyis/ ming don dang / cho ga'o/ /dang po la lnga/ gang zag gi dbye ba dang / rnal 'byor gyi dbye ba dang / dus kyi dbye ba dang / dgos pas dbye ba dang / mchod byas dbye ba'o/ /dang po la gsum/ dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma tshogs pa tshogs kyi 'khor lo zhes bya la/ /dpa' bo 'ba' zhig tshogs na dpa' bo'i ston mo/ dpa' mo 'ba' zhig tshogs na dpa' mo'i ston mo/ /gnyis pa rnal 'byor gyis phye na/ lha'i rnal 'byor mi mthun pa du ma tshogs na mdza' ba 'dus pa/ gsum pa dus kyis phye na sbyin sreg dang rab gnas kyi dus la tsa ru'i bza' ba/ bzhi pa dgos pas phye na/ lha grangs dang mthun pa de'i 'bag byas te tshar bcad pa la sogs pa'i dus su byas na sangs rgyas kyi gar ro/ /lnga pa mchod byas phye na/ bye brag tu 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mkha' 'gro ma 'ba' zhig mchod na rigs ldan ma mchod pa dang / gzhon nu ma'i ston mo/ zhes gnyis kyi ming thob bo/ /de dag kyang mngon par rtogs pa gcig yin pas zhes gsungs la/ des na/ nang tshan gyi dbye ba so so la ming so sor btags pa ni so so'i khyad par shes par bya ba'i phyir yin gyi spyi ming 'gog par byed pa ma yin no/ /gal te yin na/ dpa' bo'i ston mo la sogs pa bdun po de rgyun gyi bza' ba'i dam tshig ni yin don med la/ de'i phyir bza' ba'i dam tshig gang yang min par thal lo// //de ltar 'bad las bsod nams gang thob pa/ /de yis 'gro kun log pa'i lam spangs nas/ /yang dag lam la legs par brtson byas te/ /kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i grong du 'jug par shog /ces pa 'di gtsang byams pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis/ sa mo phag lo khrums kyi zla ba'i yar tshes bcu gnyis la/ chos grwa chen po dpal ldan sa skya'i grang mo che'i gtsug lag khang du bris pa'o//
